gap: Couples mugs are mostly text (Mr & Mrs, quotes, names and dates), engraving, pottery or flat vector. The only watercolor lovebirds found are single-scene stoneware mugs (Dean Crouser, $16.99-18). No all-over watercolor lovebird wrap and no accent-mug pair turned up. Angle: an all-over wrap of painted lovebird pairs (three coats: green, aqua and gold, rosy faces) among garden roses and hearts, no lettering, so two mugs make a matching set in the accent colours (pink, red, light green).
trend: Matching sets for couples are a steady seller in the guides; hearts and paired symbols are the shared language; mugs convert well in Valentine's season. All-over wraps lead printed mugs in the owner's Etsy scan.
